name: labs/vadter__hantek1008c
title: Hantek 1008C eight-channel USB instrument (pyhantek1008C.Hantek1008)
intro: Hantek 1008C eight-channel USB instrument (pyhantek1008C.Hantek1008), adapted from vadter/hantek1008c. It reads `active_channels`, `time`, `vscales`, `generator_waveform_max_length` and 1 more; sets `generator_on` and `generator_speed`; runs `set_generator_waveform`, `pause`, `resume` and `generator_off`. `set_generator_waveform`: send a generator waveform: one byte per part of the wave, each bit an output. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/vadter__hantek1008c --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/vadter__hantek1008c --backend fake --mcp
